response.text: Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day, or on a day covered by a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief [2]. On those days, the discharge must end by 11:00 p.m. [2]. If weather makes discharge impractical or unsafe, the next day before or after Victoria Day or Canada Day becomes the designated day [2]. Discharge is not allowed on land you do not own unless the owner has given prior written consent [2]. Outside the designated days, a special occasions permit is required, and it limits discharge to the date, time and location it specifies [3]. Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day (or the next day before or after if weather makes it impractical or unsafe), and not after 11:00 p.m. on those days [2]. On other days you need a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief [2][3]. Discharging on land other than your own requires the owner's prior written consent [2].
